name: When do I need to repair or replace my sliding door screen?

mainEntity.name: When do I need to repair or replace my sliding door screen?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider repair or replacement if you notice tears, holes, loose mesh, or significant fraying that allows insects in or compromises visibility. A screen that repeatedly comes out of its frame, has a bent or damaged frame, or whose rollers are sticking also indicates a need for service. Addressing these issues promptly prevents further damage and ensures your screen provides effective insect protection and smooth operation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair or replace if you see tears, holes, loose mesh, a damaged frame, or sticking rollers to maintain insect protection and function.
